newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Waste Management sees improved yr result.
newsitem.headline: Waste Management sees improved yr result.

text.p: Waste Management New Zealand Ltd said on Thursday it was unlikely to maintain its first quarter earnings growth throughout the year but was confident full-year operating earnings would improve on 1996.

"While your directors do not expect our first quarter earnings growth to be maintained at the same level for the full '97 year, by focusing on improving and growing our core business we remain confident that the company's full-year operating earnings will improve over '96," Waste Management told shareholders at its annual meeting.
The company posted a NZ$7.54 million net profit in the year to December 31, 1996.
